results.name: Notes Orbit clean-load attack: Pin, Duplicate and Delete work without a prior editor Save, and do not adopt unrelated revisions
Notes Orbit Save→Pin uses its own acknowledged new revision, retains edited text and performs exactly two commits
Notes Orbit Save→Duplicate copies the newly saved body and a 500-code-unit Unicode title without splitting its last surrogate pair
Notes Orbit Save→Delete: Cancel keeps the just-saved record, a genuine writer during confirmation is not adopted as delete consent, and a later confirmed delete succeeds
Native Writer: a real blocked recovery write exceeds the four-second close timeout; Cancel/edit/unlock cannot late-close the window or lose the newer recovery bytes
No uncaught browser exceptions during native note/Writer ownership checks
